notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
[b][u]Patch 1.4[/u][/b][list]

[*] Dynamic theme song (subject to change)
[*] Windowed mode more stable
[*] Opening Spellbook during level now shows the draw order (to help play around bad rng)
[*] Extra visuals (scoring, lighting)
[*] Hearts buffs can no longer land on other hearts
[*] Infinite loop with smiley spells patched
[/list]
